job.title: Direct Support Professional
job.description:
Help adults with disabilities with their day in LaBase Living's small staffed homes in Cedar Rapids and Marion, Iowa: cooking, errands, appointments, medication support, community life. Company vehicle on the job. Training before your first solo shift (CPR and First Aid, medication training, person specific training). Live in option at $225 a day, five days on and two off.

Requirements: high school diploma or GED, or two years of caregiving; valid driver's license; Iowa criminal history and dependent adult and child abuse registry checks; authorized to work in the US. Equal opportunity employer.

Apply in two minutes on your phone: labasecareers.com. Office (319) 777-8705, info@labaseliving.com. LaBase Living is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Overnight Residential Support Staff
job.description:
Overnight support in LaBase Living's small staffed homes in Cedar Rapids and Marion, Iowa. Keep the home safe and calm through the night, help anyone who needs something, hand a clean note to the morning shift. Company vehicle on the job, training before your first solo shift. Requirements: diploma or GED, or two years of caregiving; valid driver's license; Iowa background and abuse registry checks; authorized to work in the US. Equal opportunity employer.

Apply in two minutes on your phone: labasecareers.com. Office (319) 777-8705, info@labaseliving.com. LaBase Living is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Case Manager
job.description:
Coordinate person centered services across LaBase Living's staffed homes and host homes in Cedar Rapids, Iowa: keep Individual Support Plans current, be the point of contact for families, guardians and MCO care coordinators, review documentation, support intake and referrals. Requirements: bachelor's degree in a human services field or equivalent experience; Iowa Medicaid HCBS experience preferred; valid driver's license; background checks. Starting at $22 an hour depending on experience. Equal opportunity employer.

Apply in two minutes on your phone: labasecareers.com. Office (319) 777-8705, info@labaseliving.com. LaBase Living is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Remote Support Professional
job.description:
Support LaBase Living's members by video and live check ins from our support center in the Cedar Rapids area, and send a caregiver out when hands on help is needed. Office based, first and second shift, two openings. We train and certify you.

Needed: comfortable with a computer and video calls, clear spoken and written English, a valid driver's license, Iowa background checks, work authorization, two years of caregiving or DSP work or a high school diploma.

Apply in two minutes on your phone: labasecareers.com. Office (319) 777-8705, info@labaseliving.com. LaBase Living is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
Run the front of LaBase Living's Cedar Rapids office, 9am to 5pm, 40 hours a week: answer incoming calls and make outbound calls, keep member and staff files organized, greet and work with guests, applicants and new staff, and help onboard new employees and independent contractors. Other duties as assigned by the Executive Director.

Needed: good spoken and written communication, a friendly manner, computer skills, a team player.

Apply in two minutes on your phone: labasecareers.com. Office (319) 777-8705, info@labaseliving.com. LaBase Living is an equal opportunity employer.
job.salary: $17 to $20 an hour, based on experience

job.title: Host Home Provider
job.description:
Open your home to one adult with a disability and share family life. LaBase Living matches the person to your household, trains you before anyone moves in, pays you (compensation set by the person's support needs, often tax free under federal rules), backs you up around the clock and arranges scheduled respite. Contracted role in the Cedar Rapids, Des Moines and Ankeny areas.

Needed: every adult in the household passes Iowa criminal and abuse registry checks, the home passes a LaBase safety review, LaBase host home training, a signed provider agreement. No healthcare background required.

Apply in two minutes on your phone: labasecareers.com. Office (319) 777-8705, info@labaseliving.com. LaBase Living is an equal opportunity employer.
job.salary: Compensation set by the support needs of the person who lives with you; covered on the first call
